title: エリザベス女王杯にむけて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the day of the Queen Elizabeth II Cup, and everyone has their eyes on Daiwa Scarlet instead of me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But I'll stay true to myself regardless! In order to become my ideal princess, I'll send everyone flying with a good wallop!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After all, I'm sure there are people out there who support me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With my secret special move, I'll seize the throne to become the strongest queen ever! Hiyah! Princess☆Dynamite!
